cases.name: Jennifer Chandler Evans Lilly
cases.about:
Her obituary said: "Jennifer was born into a military family and was raised in several military bases, including Andrews Air Force Base, Fort Hood, and Fort Bragg.
She graduated from Westover Senior High School in Fayetteville and attended East Carolina University. She has resided in the Vanceboro community for the past 15 years. Jennifer worked at Chili's and U.S. Cellular in Greenville and later worked for Alltel and had her own home cleaning business in Vanceboro. In recent years, she developed a love for photography and began working as a photographer. Athletic by nature, she enjoyed and excelled at swimming, tap dance, and gymnastics. She loved shopping and most importantly, being a mother. She attended Holly Hill Pentecostal Holiness Church."
cases.narrative:
He shot and killed her with a shotgun in front of her 12-year-old daughter.

Jennifer was in the act of collecting things to leave Lilly with her two children, who were in the home at the time. Lilly’s sister was also in the house. He first beat his wife, then chased her son out of the house with a shotgun. He returned and, finding her locked behind a door, kicked it in and shot her.
